scope: Production GET/browser/network verification; one add-to-cart POST held then aborted before server commit; no form, call, message or order.

R4-01.reason: Production JS still has the 4000ms client redirect. Holding the exact add-to-cart POST triggered checkout at ~4.8s, then empty cart before the POST was aborted at 6.5s.

R17-01.reason: 301 aliases preserve orderby/UTM and browser sort matches direct destination, but implementation forwards every query key including redirect_to/unknown; prohibited action parameters were not safely staged, so allowlist/safety acceptance is unmet.

R2-14.reason: Three exact SKUs now resolve in live and full search; title, knowledge, mixed intent, empty/noindex, keyboard and mobile paths remain. Full product cards still omit price and a clear view/select action.

R5-01.reason: Main PDP image is eager/high and starts near 1.3s, but three matched runs show median LCP 5172ms versus 4756ms baseline; browser also requests four hidden related images marked eager/high, violating prioritization scope.

R2-10.reason: Contact distinguishes direct support 08:00–21:30, showroom 08:00–21:00 and 24/7 intake, but footer/listing/PDP still promise Zalo support 24/7; Tết listing says phone until 22:00; shipping/refund promises remain inconsistent.
